verdict.rationale: Zapier Copilot is referenced as a way to create workflows/agents with natural-language help (zapier-docs-8), and MCP-based prompting lets an AI 'call the right Zapier action' from plain language (zapier-docs-20), but there is no detailed documentation or independent evidence showing full multi-step Zap creation or editing purely from a prompt. missing for 10: dedicated Copilot documentation on generating/editing full Zap workflows, hands-on or independent verification of NL-to-workflow accuracy, and coverage of editing existing workflows via prompt.
